stories.headline: SpaceX Proposes $55B Terafab Semiconductor Facility in Texas, Total Capex Could Reach $119B

key_facts.fact: SpaceX is proposing to spend $55 billion to begin construction of a next-generation, vertically integrated semiconductor manufacturing and advanced computing fabrication facility in Grimes County, Texas
key_facts.excerpt: The notice states SpaceX is proposing construction of a multi-phase, next-generation, vertically integrated semiconductor manufacturing and advanced computing fabrication facility

key_facts.fact: The estimated total capital investment could rise to $119 billion if additional phases of the project are completed
key_facts.excerpt: The county's notice estimates $55 billion in capital investment for initial phases, and up to $119 billion total if additional phases are built

key_facts.fact: The facility would be located at the Gibbons Creek Reservoir and surrounding areas in Grimes County, approximately 20 miles east of Bryan-College Station
key_facts.excerpt: The reservoir is located off Highway 30 in a rural area of Grimes County, approximately 20 miles east of Bryan-College Station

key_facts.fact: Grimes County Commissioners Court will hold a public hearing on June 3, 2026 to consider approval of a property tax abatement agreement for SpaceX
key_facts.excerpt: The Grimes County Commissioners Court is scheduled to hold a public hearing at 9 a.m. June 3, 2026, at the Grimes County Justice & Business Center

key_facts.fact: The project involves a designated reinvestment zone called 'SpaceX Reinvestment Zone No. 1 - 2026-001'
key_facts.excerpt: The proposed agreement involves SpaceX and a designated reinvestment zone known as 'SpaceX Reinvestment Zone No. 1 - 2026-001'

stories.headline: Samsung Electronics Reaches $1 Trillion Market Cap, Second Asian Company After TSMC to Hit Milestone

key_facts.fact: Samsung Electronics' market capitalization reached 1,500 trillion won ($1.03 trillion), making it the second Asian company after TSMC to reach the milestone
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Electronics, the world's top memory chipmaker, saw its market value reach 1,500 trillion won ($1.03 trillion) in early trading in Seoul on Wednesday

key_facts.fact: Samsung shares soared 14.4% to an all-time high on May 6, with the stock more than quadrupling over the past year on the AI chip boom
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung's shares soared 14.4 per cent to an all-time high on May 6, making it only the second Asian company, after TSMC, to hit the mark

key_facts.fact: The rally pushed the Kospi benchmark above 7,000 for the first time, surging 6.45% to close at 7,384.56
key_facts.excerpt: The Kospi closed above the 7,000 level for the first time on May 6, surging 6.45 per cent to 7,384.56

key_facts.fact: Samsung's semiconductor arm delivered record quarterly profit in Q1, with operating profit surging 750% YoY to 57.2 trillion won
key_facts.excerpt: The firm said last week that operating profit surged 750 per cent on-year to a record first-quarter high of 57.2 trillion won

key_facts.fact: Samsung overtook Berkshire Hathaway and Walmart to rank 11th globally by market cap; only 13 companies worldwide have reached $1 trillion
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Electronics reaches the coveted $1 trillion market cap milestone, overtaking Berkshire Hathaway and Walmart to rank 11th in the world

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix, valued at $780 billion, also surged 10.6% to a record high; together with Samsung, they account for 44% of the Kospi's total value
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung and its memory peer SK Hynix, which leapt 10.6 per cent to a record high, together account for 44 per cent of the Kospi benchmark index's total value
